risks.risk: Wrong focal length stated by seller (60mm claimed vs 50mm shown). This affects compatibility and value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the lens nameplate showing the focal length clearly (the exact '50mm' or '60mm' text) plus the full front ring.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as not matching the stated 60mm and price for the shown 50mm lens only.

risks.proof: Ask for a close-up video/photo of the front element and rear element under bright light at angles (including edges), plus a shot with the lens held against a light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed 'like new' (assume possible wear) and do not price at top-of-market.

risks.risk: Mount/contacts and aperture mechanism condition unknown (could be damaged or sticky).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the rear mount contacts and a short clip showing aperture blades moving when the lens is tilted/operated (or a test in-camera).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service/with uncertain function.

risks.risk: Compatibility unknown (Nikon F-mount vs other mount).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the rear mount showing the exact mount type and a photo of the lens on the camera body (or the camera mount it fits).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/assume it may not fit your camera without confirmation.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the lens nameplate showing the focal length (confirm 50mm vs 60mm) and the exact model text.
Send front and rear element close-ups under bright light (angled shots to reveal fungus/haze/scratches).
Send a clear photo of the rear mount (contacts) and a short clip showing aperture movement / in-camera test.
Confirm mount type by showing the lens attached to the exact camera body (or show the mount clearly).
